question.text: Which of the following explain the poling process?

options.text: Reduction of metallic oxide impurities to metal by <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>
Reduction of metallic oxide impurities to metal by gaseous hydrocarbon
Electrolytic reduction of metallic oxide to metal
Removal of volatile oxides from the molten metal

solution.text: In poling process molten impure metal is stirred with green wood. Green wood releases hydrocarbon gases which reduced the impurities of metal oxides to metal.
